project_description: Personal Evernote replacement with Netflix-style UI and glassmorphism design
objective: Build streamlined note-taking app with core features: tags, notes, notebooks, starred notes, recently added notes. Replace bloated Evernote with gorgeous UI/UX.

frontend.ui_pattern: Netflix-inspired card interface with hover animations

completed_features: Successfully imported 559 notes from Evernote with 1,496 images

token_saving_rules: Use PowerShell scripts over Python (Python not in PATH)
Filter data before reading large files into context
Write code to files, don't output full code in responses
One script call > many individual tool calls
Preview data with LIMIT queries before full reads
